limitations: Only the 2025 league-tag and series public archives were searched for the target season. Missing or untagged markets outside those indices cannot be established absent. The separate 2026 recent-market survey contributes zero rows.
Prices-history is a historical chart observed later, not time-stamped executable bid/ask, fee, depth or a contemporaneous order receipt. All scores are descriptive on a partial late-season subset.
The event list includes separate More Markets pages for the same match. The fixture column is deduplicated on exact kickoff and oriented teams. Prior-season games are outside the model target.
retrieval_method: Frozen T−30 min. For each labelled side use the latest unique public chart observation within [T−40,T−30], maximum timing difference between sides 5 min. Both prices must lie strictly in (0,1). Same oriented clubs, exact kickoff UTC, 90 minutes plus stoppage, two-way payout must agree with regular-time score. Retrieval is bounded to the 24 h before scheduled kickoff; data beyond anchor never enters the benchmark.
